about: The sources of this project's subject matter (state-space control as taught in Advanced Automation, and the MATLAB functions the labs show), apart from the design rules' bibliography, which keeps the design principles.

entries.title: Advanced Automation (AAU), lecture slides
entries.venue: FH Technikum Wien, master's programme, summer term 2021; file AAU_SS2021_Folien_v1_2Seiten.pdf, 71 PDF pages, two slides a page
entries.backs: Every equation cited as 'slides p. N' (PDF page): notation, RNF and BNF (pp. 8–9), Q_S and Q_B (pp. 6–7), stability (pp. 9–10), pole placement and prefilter (pp. 11–18), observer (pp. 23–27), LQ (pp. 14–15), Butterworth (pp. 31–32), linearisation (pp. 56–59), and the MATLAB of pp. 18 and 33. entries.title: MATLAB and Control System Toolbox reference pages: stepinfo, place, lqr, lsim, step, feedback, pidtune, pidtuneOptions, tf2ss, ctrb, ode45
entries.backs: The argument orders and defaults in src/labs/matlab.js: stepinfo RiseTimeLimits [0.1 0.9] and SettlingTimeThreshold 0.02 by default; place makes eig(A − BK) = p, the observer is place(A',C',p)', and place refuses a pole of multiplicity above rank(B); lqr returns K with u = −Kx and P = eig(A − BK); lsim's fourth argument is the initial state, [y,tOut,x] = lsim(...) and step(...); feedback is negative by default; pidtune(sys,'PI',opts), PhaseMargin 60° and DesignFocus 'balanced' by default; tf2ss puts the negated denominator in the first row; acker has no current reference page (MATLAB Answers calls it undocumented), so the labs prefer place except for repeated poles.

entries.title: python-control 0.10.2 reference pages: place, place_acker, lqr, control.matlab.step, control.matlab.stepinfo, control.matlab.lsim
entries.backs: The calls in src/labs/python.js: place(A, B, p) makes A − BK have the eigenvalues p and will not place a pole more than rank(B) times; place_acker's page says it returns a 2-D K, the installed 0.10.2 returns a 1-D array (hence np.atleast_2d); lqr returns K, S, E with u = −Kx; step and lsim return yout, T (and xout); stepinfo(sysdata, T, yfinal, SettlingTimeThreshold=0.02, RiseTimeLimits=(0.1, 0.9)). Found by running: place raises 'Complex poles must come with their conjugates' for Butterworth poles computed with exp(), so they are rounded first; tf2ss gives the companion form with −a in the first row.
